bias_targets.target: Social biases (including age, disability, gender, nationality, race/ethnicity, religion, socioeconomic status, and sexual orientation)
bias_targets.methodology: Multiple-choice question answering using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) evaluation. The benchmark measures model accuracy on ambiguous questions (to detect reliance on stereotypes when no correct answer is provided) and disambiguated questions (to test if stereotypes override provided factual context).
